kind: Separately frozen exact-source API engineering controls; three unchanged prior scripts, not new blind experiments

cases.script:
# neutralisation
add v1 water 100mL @ 25C
inspect v1
add v1 H+ 0.001mol
add v1 water 0.001mol
add v1 OH- 0.001mol
inspect v1
wait 10s
inspect v1
cases.expectation: Bare H+/OH- remain owned; after explicit basis input no solution reading is assigned and named bare-acid-base-basis limitation is retained, including after wait. No neutralization heat or products are claimed.

cases.script:
add v1 water 100mL @ 25C
add v1 HCl 0.001mol
inspect v1
add v1 NaOH 0.001mol
inspect v1
wait 10s
inspect v1
cases.expectation: Complete HCl/NaOH supported neutralization retains Na/Cl, consumes finite acid/base, produces corresponding water and reports warm near-neutral final readback; no new scientific calibration.

cases.script:
add v1 water 100mL @ 25C
add v1 H2SO4 0.001mol
inspect v1
electrolyse v1 0.1A 100s
inspect v1
wait 10s
inspect v1
cases.expectation: Supporting sulfuric acid permits ideal-current solvent electrolysis with finite water, H2:O2=2:1, unchanged supporting sulfate/proton coordinates and explicit exported gas; rate/voltage/yield calibration is not assigned.
checks: formal charge and H/O/S closure with exported gas

execution_policy: One request per script, serial with at least3.1seconds between starts; stop on auth/redirect/quota/transport ambiguity, uncompleted execution or source/binary/script mismatch; no silent retry.
comparison_scope: No local CLI execution or same-head CLI equality claim. Original design/outcomes remain immutable. These are declared API/material/reporting checks, not empirical chemical validation.
excluded_cases: 014-complete-stock: source does not include803 physicalsolid repair
